ns2:section.sectionTitle: Intl Persp on Comm Risk Mgmt
ns2:section.sectionText: Travel to Europe to study International Perspectives on Commodity Risk Management, which teaches students about the measurement and management of risks resulting from the volatility of both commodity prices and of foreign exchange rates. In Europe students will visit and interact with prominent commodity market participants as well as derivatives markets operators and regulators and will attend a 3-day teaching and research seminar at the University of Paris-Dauphine. Students registered in this section pay a study abroad fee assessed through the ACES Study Abroad Office.
